title: Fresh production functional checks for navigation and explanation levels

method.freshness: All HTTP requests and hashes were executed anew on 2026-09-08; previous reports supplied no pass/fail results. The fixed 38-destination legacy fixture supplies expected historical navigation targets only.
method.client: curl with normal certificate validation, --compressed, Cache-Control: no-cache; Python HTMLParser; no browser automation.
method.scope: Four hubs in five locales and every internal link/fragment they expose, all legacy menu targets in five locales, all current main pages and their internal links, all encountered reference detail pages, seven ordered navigation groups, page ownership, AboutTabs, source ClaimRef and anchor coverage, and four public data hashes against the current workspace.
method.renderedText: Script and style payloads excluded when looking for raw reference tokens.
method.limits: Static served HTML and HTTP checks complement the root task’s browser interaction and layout QA. External research/article URLs are not fetched. Source-expression checks use explicit literal hub IDs.
method.interpretation: Repeated per-page navigation failures describe a shared deployment regression, not independent defects. Unknown reference/claim IDs mean not found in the current workspace registry; new live-branch records may still be valid. The attached live bibliography comparison distinguishes those cases. Hub links cannot be discovered from 404 responses; expected hub anchor and ClaimRef presence is therefore reported as missing, without claiming successful link coverage for those absent pages.
